## Walkthrough

This PR changes fuzz reset behavior in main-fuzz.ts to periodically rebuild the reused fjall-hybrid values session (via a new REBUILD_FJALL_SESSION_EVERY constant and resetCount tracking) instead of always keeping it open, and restricts sharedFjallSession usage to the fjall-hybrid backend specifically. Separately, main-importer.ts and workers/importer/main.ts are updated so createImporter can accept an already-open database via a new optional db option, avoiding an unnecessary close/reopen cycle.
